note: TRUE values of the fixture CVs (what a person sees), made by tests/fixtures/make_cv_fixtures.py. All people and employers are made up.

cv01_single_classic.pdf.layout: One column. Header with name and contact line. Caps headings. Job lines 'Title | Company | Mon YYYY – Present'. Bullets. Skills with years.

cv02_two_column_interleaved.pdf.layout: Full-width header (name, title, contact). Then two columns. The stream alternates a left line and a right line, so the text of the columns is mixed in file order.
certifications: Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer

cv03_sidebar_first.pdf.layout: Narrow sidebar on the left (contact, skills, education) is written first in the file. The name is in the wide right column.

cv04_header_pipe_objective.pdf.layout: Name and title on one line separated by '|'. 'Career objective' says 'Seeking a ... position'. Dates end with 'to date'. Years only.

cv05_title_above_name_vi.pdf.layout: The title 'DATA SCIENTIST' is ABOVE the name. Vietnamese name and place with diacritics (Type0 font). The jobs list the employer and dates but no title. 'Open to ... roles'.
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate

cv06_caps_bullets_mixed.pdf.layout: All-caps headings and all-caps job lines. Bullet glyphs '▪', '●', '–' and '•' (Type0 font). Dates 'MM/YYYY – now'. Skill ratings written with dots.

cv07_linkedin_export.pdf.layout: LinkedIn-style export: sidebar with Contact, Top Skills, Certifications, Honors-Awards is written first. Main column: name, headline 'Title at Company | ...', Summary, Experience in the order company / title / dates, two roles in one company.

cv08_europass_like.pdf.layout: Europass-like: 'JOB APPLIED FOR' label with a role. Work experience lines start with the date range 'DD/MM/YYYY – Present' and then the title. Employer on the next line. Label 'Job-related skills'.

cv09_docx_simple.docx.layout: DOCX, one column. Title under the name. Job line with a tab and the date on the right. List bullets are Symbol glyphs. Sentence 'I aspire to grow into a ... role'.

cv10_docx_table_two_column.docx.layout: DOCX two-column layout made with a table. The left cell (small text: contact, skills, certifications) comes first in the file. The name is in the right cell with the big font.
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate

cv11_docx_textbox_header.docx.layout: DOCX where the name and the title are in the page HEADER part, and the contact details are in a TEXT BOX that Word stores twice (Choice and Fallback). Title with the abbreviation 'Sr.'.

cv12_student_intern.pdf.layout: Student CV. Current role is an internship that ended (latest end date). Objective: 'Looking for a graduate ... role'. Awards and a certification.

cv13_no_target_awards.pdf.layout: No wish for a job. Words 'Looking after a team' and 'Looking forward to hearing from you' must NOT give a target role. Awards section with three kinds. Lead by title.

cv14_principal.pdf.layout: Principal level from the title word. 'Open to Head of AI roles' names a role that is not in the role list: the reader must leave the target empty.

awards.name: Best Paper Award, Applied AI Workshop
Patent Filed: Low-latency Model Serving Method

cv15_oldest_first.pdf.layout: Jobs are listed from the oldest to the newest. The current job (Present) is the LAST one.

cv16_ligatures_hyphen_pua.pdf.layout: Ligature glyphs (ﬁ, ﬂ), bullets that are private-use characters, words cut with a hyphen at the end of a line, words drawn one by one with no space glyph, spaces written as TJ numbers. Title 'Sr Backend Developer'.

cv17_no_dates_statement.pdf.layout: No dates at all. The role and the years come from the summary sentence 'Data analyst with 6 years of experience'. 'Interested in moving into ... roles'.

cv18_minimal.pdf.layout: Almost empty CV: name, contact, a degree with dates, and three skills. Nothing about jobs. Every field must stay empty (no guess).

cv19_docx_stacked_open_to.docx.layout: DOCX. Jobs are stacked: company, title, dates (full month names), place. 'Open to A or B roles': two target roles. Mixed-case headings. Skills with labels.

cv20_flipped_form_header.pdf.layout: The page is drawn with a flipped y axis (1 0 0 -1 0 842 cm, like Cairo). The name and the title are in a form XObject. Title 'Staff ...' is the Lead level.

cv21_inline_at_dates.pdf.layout: Job lines 'Title at Company (YYYY–YYYY)'. Sentence 'Currently looking for roles in MLOps' names no known role (MLOps alone is a skill, not a role). Skills in 'Label: items' lines.

cv22_latex_timeline.pdf.layout: LaTeX-like (moderncv): centred name and title, a timeline with the DATES in a left column and the text in a right column, spaces as TJ kerning numbers, font with an /Encoding /Differences list (en dash, fi).

awards.name: Gold medal, ICPC Regional Programming Contest

cv23_two_equal_columns_right_first.pdf.layout: Two equal columns under a full-width header with a headline 'Junior Data Analyst | skills'. The right column (education, skills, certifications) is written first in the file.

cv24_two_page_band.pdf.layout: One column on two pages with a band of two columns (CERTIFICATIONS | LANGUAGES) at the end of page 1 that goes on at the top of page 2 (certifications on the left, WORK RIGHTS AND AVAILABILITY on the right). No gutter for the whole page: most lines cross the middle.
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate
